title: DR1 calls the page where the user enters animal and package counts "Commodity details"; the frontend calls it "Consignment details".

finding.frontend: The page heading is "Consignment details" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/copy/copy.en.js:16), and the same words appear in the breadcrumb and the browser tab title. The page itself is entirely about commodities: a Selected commodities summary with a Remove per row, an "Add another commodity" link, and a number of animals and number of packages per species.
finding.prototype: The heading on the same page is "Commodity details" (app/views/consignment-details.html:45), and DR1 uses "About the consignment" as the caption above it, so the two words are doing different jobs — the caption names the section, the heading names the page. The frontend's heading takes the word the caption uses in DR1.
finding.difference: Rename the page heading from "Consignment details" to "Commodity details" and follow the new name through the breadcrumb and the browser tab title, which both take the heading today. No hub task row needs to move with it, because no hub row leads to this page — the hub's "What are you importing?" row goes to the commodity picker and this page is reached from there. Two other places already use "Commodity details" for something else and have to be checked for a collision before the rename lands: the hub's heading for section 2, which groups the additional-details and animal-identification rows rather than this page (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/copy/copy.en.js:20), and the check-answers group labels, which carry "Consignment details" and "Commodity details" side by side as two different groups (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:41-44). The heading is a whole-page name rather than a control, so this finding names no control and the report will show the whole page.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "Commodity details" used as this page's heading anywhere in the frontend.
finding.verification: Read both rendered DOMs and both full-page screenshots. The frontend heading, breadcrumb and tab title all read "Consignment details" (fe-consignment-details.html:3, :98, :117); DR1 has the caption "About the consignment" over the heading "Commodity details" (dr1-consignment-details.html:258-259). Both cited lines resolve exactly. Ran the falsifier as a grep for "Commodity details" across the live-animals source: it is never this page's heading, so the finding is not falsified, but it is already in use twice elsewhere in the frontend, which the difference slot did not account for. Claim CORRECT; one factual error in the difference slot fixed — see correction.
finding.correction: Claimed: "Check the hub task row that leads here at the same time, so a user is not sent to a page by one name and met by another." There is no such row. The captured hub (fe-hub.html:126-210) has three rows under "1. About the consignment" and two under "2. Commodity details", and none of the five points at the consignment-details page — it is reached by saving and continuing from the commodity picker. The advice would have sent whoever picks this up looking for something that does not exist, so the slot has been corrected. Running the falsifier turned up the thing that advice was reaching for: "Commodity details" is already the hub's name for section 2, whose rows are the additional-details and animal-identification pages, and it is already one of two check-answers group labels sitting next to "Consignment details". The rename is still right, but it collides with two existing uses and the difference slot now says so.
